stem: Meena's mother wants to make butter at home. She has fresh curd ready in a large bowl. In which situation is churning the suitable method to obtain butter or cream?

options.text: When salt has to be recovered from salty water
When butter has to be separated from curd made from milk
When sand has to be removed from drinking water
When small stones have to be picked out of rice

teacher.key_rationale: Churning separates butter (or cream) from curd or milk by agitation. Options A, C and D require evaporation/crystallisation, filtration and hand-picking respectively, so B is the key.
